high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @stockmarket_times. The post is titled "KEY DECISIONS TAKEN BY CABINET" and is part of a series, as indicated by the "4/4" at the top right corner, suggesting it is the final part of a four-part series. The content of the post highlights two key decisions made by the cabinet: A huge reduction in bank guarantee requirements (80%) against License Fee (LF) and other similar Levies. Interest rates rationalized and penalties removed. The background of the post is black with yellow and white text
